en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Ja`far al-Himyari narrated to us. He said: Harun b. Muslim narrated to us from Mas`ada b. Sadaqa from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers from `Ali b. Abi Talib (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

The believers have seven rights over one another that Allah has obligated for them: (1) honour regarding his eye, (2) love regarding his heart, (3) being considerate with his wealth, (4) the prohibition of backbiting him, (5) visitation of him when he is ill, (6) attending his funeral, and (7) that nothing is said about him after his death except that which is good.
